items.title: R-universality of a unitary algebra over a quaternion division algebra in terms of the reduced norm and the even Clifford algebra

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the R-universality criterion for a unitary algebra over a quaternion division algebra with the reversion involution (author lem at source lines 720-735, label SO(quat)), with the criterion split according to the parity of the size into a reduced-norm square condition and a splitting condition for the even Clifford algebra. The proof (source lines 737-765) identifies the Tits algebra of the natural representation with the division algebra (proof lines 740-743), then treats the two parities separately: in the even case the remaining classes are quaternion algebras and can be compared after base change, while in the odd case the even Clifford algebra governs the answer (proof lines 743-764). The parity split is what makes the two alternatives. H2.
